items.title: Living Blueprint Foundation Release
items.description: Release focused on metamodel setup, import quality, source synchronization, and stakeholder validation for initial architecture trust.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve data freshness and validation confidence.
Increase completeness of the first production model.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase the number of decisions supported by current model evidence.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Reduce manual effort needed to update assigned architecture objects after source evidence changes.
Increase practitioner confidence that assigned objects are complete enough for review usage.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase the number of accepted architecture recommendations supported by current model evidence.

productBricks.change: Improve guided metamodel setup and validation rules.
Improve spreadsheet and legacy-tool import mapping.
Add model health dashboard and missing-data work queues.

deliveryChannels.change: Roll out guided import and data-quality views.
Deploy validation and quality scoring services.

items.title: Portfolio Rationalization Release
items.description: Release focused on application portfolio scoring, cost attribution, lifecycle exposure, and executive rationalization decision packs.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase the share of priority applications with complete decision evidence.
Reduce time from candidate identification to decision approval.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase annualized savings and risk reduction from approved portfolio actions.

productBricks.change: Improve rationalization scoring and recommendation explanations.
Add configurable cost attribution rules and finance imports.
Add lifecycle exposure alerts for priority technologies.
Publish CIO portfolio decision pack templates.

deliveryChannels.change: Deploy scoring and lifecycle analytics updates.
Deploy cost and lifecycle connector updates.

items.title: Transformation Roadmap Release
items.description: Release focused on capability-based roadmaps, strategic portfolio fit, scenario comparison, and value realization tracking.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve evidence coverage for roadmap milestones.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve value traceability and milestone predictability.

productBricks.change: Improve roadmap horizon modeling and target-state views.
Add strategic fit scorecards for initiatives.
Improve scenario comparison across dependency, value, risk, and timing.
Add value realization baselines and progress tracking.

deliveryChannels.change: Roll out updated roadmap and scenario planning workspace.
Deploy scenario and value tracking services.

items.title: Risk and AI Governance Release
items.description: Release focused on control mapping, exception governance, AI system evidence, audit exports, and architecture release readiness.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase coverage of critical applications and AI systems with mapped controls.
Reduce effort to prepare architecture-linked control evidence.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Reduce critical risks without owner, mitigation, or approved exception.

productBricks.change: Add control mapping templates for AI, technology lifecycle, and resilience.
Add evidence-grounded AI summaries for risk and control reviews.
Add release readiness checks for high-risk changes.

deliveryChannels.change: Roll out risk, control, and evidence review improvements.
Expose reviewer-friendly AI and control status summaries.
Deploy updated governance and evidence services.
